mathematical_contract.parameter_map: For a represented source parameter u, the target half-circle parameter is ordered by comparing its strictly monotone target radial coordinate against (A(u) dot(Rs,Rt) + B(u) turn(s) cross(Rs,Rt)) / D(u). The retained bivariate dot, cross, incidence, and positive squared-radius denominator keep the predicate in the two selected cusp roots without constructing a primitive element.
mathematical_contract.nested_cut: A mapped cut stores one overlap pointer, the source cut, and its source side. Rational brackets map through the monotone correspondence; full aligned overlaps reuse the cut and reversed full overlaps use its exact unit complement. Mapping back through the same correspondence collapses to the original proof.
mathematical_contract.clipping: The overlap is clipped on the first carrier, mapped to the second, clipped there, and mapped back only when the second carrier shortens it. Every mapped point is therefore known to lie on both selected half circles.
mathematical_contract.topology: Corresponding overlap endpoints receive one arrangement vertex. Existing authored/contact vertices are unioned first; each injective carrier then keeps its already-authoritative local parameter proof, so STRICT never equates unrelated algebraic encodings by approximation.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT accepts only exact correlated predicates or topology identity. APPROXIMATE_512 follows the same exact graph and may terminate only at the shared 512-bit scalar equality boundary; no approximate geometry is emitted.
